correctness.rationale: For k=1,2, a based length-n closed walk in the 2k-bit overlap graph has a periodic bit string x obtained by taking the first bit at each successive step. Shifts force the vertex at step i to be (x_i,…,x_{i+2k-1}) modulo n, also when n is shorter than the window. The edge tests then impose exactly the kth-iterate fixed-point constraints, and a labeled cyclic configuration gives the inverse walk. Thus trace counts configurations, not rotation classes. The formal log-determinant identity gives integer denominators of degrees at most 4 and 16 and the quotient D/E. On the second-iterate fixed set, the dynamics is an involution, so the difference counts exact-period-two configurations and half of it counts temporal two-orbits. Independently enumerated labeled configurations under direct cyclic updates for every rule and n=1,…,16, with no use of the uploaded graph or verifier code. The formal coefficient recurrence applied to these direct counts determines all denominator coefficients given the degree bounds. All rule entries, class memberships, 51 ordered pairs, 40 second denominators, and 25 coprime ratio classes matched. The first-witness histogram is (64,48,6,17,2,12) for 1–6, with 107 identical denominator pairs, which implies absence at every length; 12 first witnesses at six prove optimality. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/independent-checks/check_eca.py with the frozen package directory. The uploaded generator imports the verifier's computations; these are not two independent implementations. The direct reproduction is distinct. No conclusion is drawn about higher temporal periods or infinite spatial lattices.
